summary: Frontend-only smoke + functional testing for the newly added Player Stats (/players, /player) and Backup & Share (/backup) flows plus the dashboard quick-action cards. All requested testIDs render, navigate, filter, sort, and display data correctly. Demo match auto-seeds and produces 10 lifetime player rows. Web export triggers a Blob download and the toast 'Downloaded 1 matches'. Modal import flow verified structurally in code. Theme toggle works. No critical issues found.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning observed: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — appears when the backup modal mounts. Likely originates from a third-party RN-Web component (or RNGH/Modal). Not blocking, but worth filing/upgrading the offending lib when convenient.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate source of the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning when opening the Backup screen / modal and migrate to style.pointerEvents.
(Optional) Consider adding a testID for the per-player detail 'matches played' header to ease future testing.
No functional fixes required for this iteration — feature behaves as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: computeLifetimeStats correctly filters to status === 'completed' so partial in-progress matches don't pollute lifetime stats — good.
exportAndShare web path correctly uses Blob + URL.createObjectURL with revokeObjectURL cleanup; result.method === 'download' so toast renders 'Downloaded X matches' as expected.
applyBackup merge path validates by id and sorts by createdAt desc — correct.
pickAndReadBackup validates payload.app === 'gullyscore.backup' before applying — good defensive check.
Touch targets (44x44 icon buttons, 52px primary/secondary buttons, 36px sort chips) all comfortable for mobile.
All text wrapped in <Text>; only RN primitives used; styles via StyleSheet.create — RN best practices followed.
seed_data_creation: None added manually — relied on the app's auto-seeded demo match (gully.demoSeeded). The demo match produces 10 player rows (Mohalla XI + Galli Tigers, 5-a-side).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested at https://live-cricket-tracker-19.preview.emergentagent.com. Demo match auto-seeds on first load. Verified: quick-players-button → /players (10 player rows), search filter 'Rohit' narrows to 1, all 4 sort chips work, player-row-rohit → /player?key=rohit shows full batting (Inn 1, R 22, B 14, HS 22, SR 157.1, Avg 22.0, 4s 2, 6s 1) + bowling (Inn 1, O 2.0, R 14, W 2, Eco 7.00, Best 2/14) + matches-played list (1 match). Backup screen shows '1 match', export triggers Blob download with toast 'Downloaded 1 matches'. Import modal buttons (merge/replace/cancel) confirmed in code only — file picker interaction was intentionally skipped per request. Theme toggle confirmed working.
